course.title: Environmental Planning and Management
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
You are assigned to a project as an Environmental Planner and your task is to (15)   
design mitigation measures for ‘X' Chemical Industry. The industry emits toxic   
wastes including toxic chemical, heavy metals, and other harmful substances.   
Under some following coindition, design a mitigation measure- process according   
to “Mitigation Measures Hierarchy”.   
1. The industry is located in a remote area   
2. The industry is near settlements   
3. The industry is beside a river   
4. The soil type of the locality is 'less compact'
